description:
You are an Offensive Coordinator digitizing a football playbook. Open the template '~/Diagrams/playbook_template.drawio' in Diagrams.net. 

IMPORTANT - HANDLE UPDATE DIALOG:
If an 'Update available' dialog appears on startup, click 'Cancel' or press Escape to dismiss it.

TASK:
Read the play call sheet at '~/Desktop/play_call_sheet.txt'. It describes the 'Spider 2 Y Banana' pass play from a 'Green Right Strong' formation.

1. SETUP THE FORMATION (Green Right Strong):
   - Arrange the Offensive Line (LT, LG, C, RG, RT) on the Line of Scrimmage (LOS).
   - Place the Quarterback (QB) under Center.
   - Place the Fullback (FB) and Halfback (HB) in an I-Formation (behind QB).
   - Place the Tight End (Y) on the right side of the line.
   - Place the Flanker (Z) on the right (off LOS).
   - Place the Split End (X) on the left (on LOS).
   - Use BLUE circles for Offense. LABEL every player (e.g., 'QB', 'Y').

2. SETUP THE DEFENSE (4-3 Under):
   - Place 4 Defensive Linemen (Red Xs) opposite the offensive line.

3. DRAW THE ROUTES (Blue Arrows):
   - FB: Run a 'Slide' route to the right flat (Curved arrow).
   - Y (Tight End): Run a 'Banana' route (Rounded/Curved corner route deep right).
   - Z (Flanker): Run a 'Shallow Cross' (Straight arrow crossing horizontally).
   - X (Split End): Run a 'Post' route (Straight arrow angling to goal post).
   - HB: Step up to block (Line with T-bar end).
   - QB: Bootleg/Rollout right (Dashed line).

4. EXPORT:
   - Save the file.
   - Export as PDF to '~/Diagrams/exports/spider_2_y_banana.pdf'.
